profile.headline: Software Engineer at Payroll Integrations
profile.summary:
As a software developer, my responsibilities consist primarily of writing and maintaining code for enterprise scale cloud applications on AWS. 
I have been programming professionally for 3 years now, with an additional 4 non-professional years while I was in college. 
I graduated Suma Cum Laude from Georgia Southwestern State University with a Bachelor's Degree of Science in Computer Science.
In my spare time, I am work on projects in video game design. Primarily, I have been developing a game engine, which has awarded me a modest general knowledge of Game Design, as well as skills in C++, Lua integrations, computer graphics, computer audio, and game process routine management.

projects.title: Personal Game Engine
projects.description:
This project is a 3D video game engine, which I am writing in C++.
This project includes a graphics pipeline using the BGFX library to perform draw calls cross-platform, using OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, and Direct3D as backends.
The game engine includes/will include support for:
GLTF scene/resource loading, and 3D node tree manipulation.
Controls mapping for keyboard and game controller inputs.
C# integration primarily using the Mono runtime, but additionally may support .NET, using the SWIG framework for generating the connecting code.
Custom shaders drawing scenes to the screen.
Support for lighting pipelines using point lights and directional lights.
Support for PBR metallic roughness, normals, and color texture mapping.
Shadow mapping.
